authority: Deterministic action-level effect resolvers for technique effect profiles.

qualification_only.resolution: Satisfies only explicitly registered prerequisites or passive state. Direct activation as an action returns invalid_action.

equipment_qualification.resolution: Technique records proficiency/compatibility only. Weapon physics and unique functions resolve from the named-item registry and unique-item module registry.

operational_check.rule: The opposing capacity or environment modifier must be a saved numeric input before resolution; model prose may not substitute an unrecorded modifier.

communication_action.success: capacity >= control_demand and receiver/channel are valid
communication_action.rule: Message content is player/NPC intent, never created by the resolver.

movement_action.rule: No movement method becomes teleportation unless its effect profile explicitly says spacetime_transport=true.

close_combat_method.effect: After contact, apply registered impact/penetration/chakra-disruption parameters through data/mechanics/injury.json.

entity_control_action.rule: Every physical entity/clone/puppet/summon/swarm must resolve to a registered entity state and conserved resources before it acts.

terrain_action.rule: Terrain change is limited to the exact geometry, displacement, integrity and force in the technique effect profile.

sensory_action.rule: Detection can reveal only information supported by the registered sensory channel.

special_system.rule: Resolve only through the effect profile system_ref/special_case parameters. Missing required special state returns invalid_action.

primitive_passthrough.rule: Use the technique mechanical_base primitive plus the full registered physical_profile. No additional narrative effect is legal.
